prompts.discovery:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a NEW DESIGN CONCEPT by redesigning the existing CarbonCap app screenshot (input 1). This is a polished full desktop web-app screen, not code, not a phone mockup. Render a single screen at approximately 1600 x 1100 pixels, straight-on, large readable Thai typography.

INPUT ROLES:
1. Existing CarbonCap screenshot: preserve brand, navigation meaning, three agricultural projects and factual demo data ONLY. Completely replace the crowded all-in-one layout with the discovery view specified below.
2. Style reference: ONLY the inner GreenLife website designs, not Dribbble profile, phone status bar, Safari browser or collage. Borrow their spacious white editorial rhythm, bold friendly typography, simple flat environmental illustration, pale-blue backing areas, rounded pill controls. Reinterpret in green, sky blue and white; do not use the orange palette or GreenLife branding.
3. Actual Mae Rim satellite photograph for first project card.
4. Actual Tha Mai satellite photograph for second project card.
5. Actual Pak Chong satellite photograph for third project card.
Use the actual agricultural images as card photographs, framing them cleanly. All concept content is part of a fictional carbon-credit demonstration.

VISUAL SYSTEM:
True white #FFFFFF page, forest-green ink #173F30, green primary #2C7854, pale green #EDF7EE, pale sky blue #EAF2FF, sky-blue accents #AED1EE, muted green-gray text #6B7B72. Generous 64–80px outside gutters and clear 40–56px gaps between major regions. Modern elegant Thai sans-serif; main heading about 44px, section heading 28px, project names 24px, normal text 16px. Large white surfaces stay true white, not beige. Strong rounded corners approximately 24–30px on image cards, fully pill-shaped buttons at least 48px high. Soft realistic green-gray drop shadows gently lift cards and primary pills off the white surface. Crisp thin edges, no heavy outlines, no harsh black shadows, no neumorphic gray blobs. Buttons must feel tactile, subtle depth, not flat rectangles. Flat illustration, not 3D plastic.

INFORMATION ARCHITECTURE:
This is ONLY screen 1: choose a project. Map, AI tools, checkout and portfolio belong to separate screens and MUST NOT crowd this page.
Top quiet white header: CarbonCap wordmark on left, two essential navigation items on right: active “สำรวจโครงการ” and “พอร์ตจำลอง”. No sidebar, profile/avatar, login, settings, fake chart or big metric-card dashboard.
Below, a compact welcome band, about 230–260px tall, with plenty of breathing room. Large left-aligned heading “สำรวจโครงการเกษตร”; underneath “เลือกโครงการ แล้วดูภาพดาวเทียมและผลวิเคราะห์จำลอง”. Right third: an ORIGINAL charming flat illustration of a Thai farmer tending a sapling on a small green-and-blue globe, with a small satellite above. Blue/green clothing, neutral natural skin, green leaves, soft sky-blue organic backdrop. Slight paper-cut overlap beyond the backdrop lends depth. Keep artwork compact, do not turn it into a giant landing-page hero. No decorative eyebrow badge above heading.
Next distinct region after a generous gap: heading “เลือกโครงการของคุณ”; an unobtrusive rounded search field “ค้นหาโครงการ” and a pill status filter “ทั้งหมด”.
Three equally sized project cards in ONE open horizontal row with approximately 32px spacing, each with an actual satellite photo, generous padding and a clear soft shadow. No nested cards.
Card 1: “วนเกษตรแม่ริม”, “เชียงใหม่”, status “พร้อมซื้อจำลอง”, “120 เครดิต”, “650 บาท/เครดิต”, green capsule CTA “ดูโครงการ” with a clean small arrow icon.
Card 2: “สวนฟื้นฟูท่าใหม่”, “จันทบุรี”, status “พร้อมซื้อจำลอง”, “180 เครดิต”, “720 บาท/เครดิต”, same CTA.
Card 3: “เกษตรยั่งยืนปากช่อง”, “นครราชสีมา”, status “กำลังประเมิน”, “ติดตามความคืบหน้า”, CTA “ดูโครงการ”. Do not offer purchase for this pending project.
Keep each card's data concise and balanced, photograph and name dominant.
Small understated footer note: “ภาพดาวเทียมจาก Google Earth Engine • ข้อมูลโครงการ คาร์บอน ราคา และธุรกรรมเป็นการจำลอง”.

QUALITY:
Airy, friendly and distinctly app-like. Beautiful typography, separated functional zones, soft raised controls and rounded image cards. Match the references' sense of white space and calm environmental character. Absolutely no donation form, newsletter, unrelated marketing sections, browser chrome, phone frame, fake certifications, income guarantees, dashboard stat tiles or map/purchase form on this discovery screen. Thai words must be spelled as provided and remain legible. This is a high-quality implementable production design concept, not a wireframe.
